arxiv-1807-11868.title: Weak ergodic theorem for Markov chains without invariant countably additive measures
arxiv-1807-11868.creator: Alexander Zhdanok
arxiv-1807-11868.description: Abstract In this paper, we study Markov chains (MC) on topological spaces within the framework of the operator approach. We extend the Markov operator from the space of countably additive measures to the space of finitely additive measures. Cesaro means for a Markov sequence of measures and their asymptotic behavior in the weak topology are considered.

arxiv-2011-04354.title: Nonequilibrium model of short-range repression in gene transcription regulation
arxiv-2011-04354.creator: F.E. Garbuzov, V.V. Gursky
arxiv-2011-04354.description: Abstract Transcription factors are proteins that regulate gene activity by activating or repressing gene transcription. A special class of transcriptional repressors operates via a short-range mechanism, making local DNA regions inaccessible to binding by activators and, thus, providing an indirect repressive action on the target gene.

arxiv-2108-11056.title: Social Norm Bias: Residual Harms of Fairness-Aware Algorithms DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 Conference: Woodstock ’18: ACM Symposium on Neural Gaze Detection; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY Woodstock ’18: ACM Symposium on Neural Gaze Detection, June 03–05, 2018, Woodstock, NY Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-
arxiv-2108-11056.creator: Myra Cheng, Maria De-Arteaga, Lester Mackey, Adam Tauman Kalai
arxiv-2108-11056.description: Abstract . Many modern machine learning algorithms mitigate bias by enforcing fairness constraints across coarsely-defined groups related to a sensitive attribute like gender or race. However, these algorithms seldom account for within-group heterogeneity and biases that may disproportionately affect some members of a group.

arxiv-2205-01569.title: PSCNN: A 885.86 TOPS/W Programmable SRAM-based Computing-In-Memory Processor for Keyword Spotting
arxiv-2205-01569.creator: Shu-Hung Kuo, and Tian-Sheuan Chang, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2205-01569.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shu-Hung Kuo, and Tian-Sheuan Chang, Senior Member, IEEE. Computing-in-memory (CIM) has attracted significant attentions in recent years due to its massive parallelism and low power consumption. However, current CIM designs suffer from large area overhead of small CIM macros and bad programmablity for model execution.

arxiv-2205-12648.title: Fast Inference and Transfer of Compositional Task Structures for Few-shot Task Generalization
arxiv-2205-12648.creator: Sungryull Sohn, Hyunjae Woo, Jongwook Choi, Lyubing Qiang, Izzeddin Gur, Aleksandra Faust, Honglak Lee
arxiv-2205-12648.description: Abstract We tackle real-world problems with complex structures beyond the pixel-based game or simulator. We formulate it as a few-shot reinforcement learning problem where a task is characterized by a subtask graph that defines a set of subtasks and their dependencies that are unknown to the agent.

arxiv-2208-07737.title: Learning Efficient Abstract Planning Models that Choose What to Predict
arxiv-2208-07737.creator: Nishanth Kumar, Willie McClinton, Rohan Chitnis, Tom Silver, Tomás Lozano-Pérez, Leslie Pack Kaelbling
arxiv-2208-07737.description: Abstract An effective approach to solving long-horizon tasks in robotics domains with continuous state and action spaces is bilevel planning, wherein a high-level search over an abstraction of an environment is used to guide low-level decision-making. Recent work has shown how to enable such bilevel planning by learning abstract models in the form of symbolic operators and neural samplers.

arxiv-2208-08152.title: Distortion of Hausdorff measures under Orlicz-Sobolev maps
arxiv-2208-08152.creator: Andrea Cianchi
arxiv-2208-08152.description: Abstract A comprehensive theory of the effect of Orlicz-Sobolev maps, between Euclidean spaces, on subsets with zero or finite Hausdorff measure is offered. Arbitrary Orlicz-Sobolev spaces embedded into the space of continuous function and Hausdorff measures built upon general gauge functions are included in our discussion.

arxiv-2209-03044.title: Centering toric arrangements of maximal rank
arxiv-2209-03044.creator: Elia Saini
arxiv-2209-03044.description: Abstract . The homotopy type of the complement manifold of a complexified toric arrangement has been investigated by d’Antonio and Delucchi in a paper that shows the minimality of such topological space. In this work we associate to a given toric arrangement a matrix that represents the arrangement over the integers.

arxiv-2211-01377.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ryan Dungee, Jennifer van Saders, Eric Gaidos, Mark Chun, Rafael A. García, Eugene A. Magnier, Savita Mathur, Ângela R. G. Santos. We present stellar rotation periods for late K and early M dwarf members of the 4 Gyr-old open cluster M67 as calibrators for gyrochronology and tests of stellar spin-down models.

arxiv-2307-07850.title: Scope of the action principle
arxiv-2307-07850.creator: Ward Struyve
arxiv-2307-07850.description: Abstract Laws of motion given in terms of differential equations can not always be derived from an action principle, at least not without introducing auxiliary variables. By allowing auxiliary variables, e.g. in the form of Lagrange multipliers, an action is immediately obtained.

arxiv-2308-02366.title: The formation of star-forming disks in the TNG50 simulation Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2308-02366.creator: Enci Wang, Simon J. Lilly
arxiv-2308-02366.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Enci Wang, Simon J. Lilly. We investigate the disk formation process in the TNG50 simulation, examining the profiles of SFR surface density ( Σ SFR \Sigma_{\rm SFR} ), gas inflow and outflow, and the evolution of the angular momentum of inflowing gas particles. The TNG50 galaxies tend to have larger star-forming disks, and also show larger deviations from exponential profiles in Σ SFR \Sigma_{\rm SFR} when compared to real galaxies in the MaNGA (Mapping Nearby Galaxies at APO) survey.

arxiv-2404-03317.description: Abstract Context . HAT-P-67 b is one of the lowest-density gas giants known to date, making it an excellent target for atmospheric characterization through the transmission spectroscopy technique. Aims . In the framework of the GAPS large programme, we collected four transit events of HAT-P-67 b with the aim of studying the exoplanet atmosphere and deriving the orbital projected obliquity.

arxiv-2409-09875.title: Scaling Continuous Kernels with Sparse Fourier Domain Learning
arxiv-2409-09875.creator: Clayton Harper, Luke Wood, Peter Gerstoft, Eric C. Larson
arxiv-2409-09875.description: Abstract We address three key challenges in learning continuous kernel representations: computational efficiency , parameter efficiency , and spectral bias . Continuous kernels have shown significant potential, but their practical adoption is often limited by high computational and memory demands. Additionally, these methods are prone to spectral bias, which impedes their ability to capture high-frequency details.

arxiv-2409-12336.title: Electromagnetized black holes and swirling backgrounds in nonlinear electrodynamics: The ModMax case
arxiv-2409-12336.creator: José Barrientos, Adolfo Cisterna, Mokhtar Hassaine, Konstantinos Pallikaris
arxiv-2409-12336.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by José Barrientos, Adolfo Cisterna, Mokhtar Hassaine, Konstantinos Pallikaris. This work focuses on constructing electromagnetized black holes and vortex-like backgrounds within the framework of the ModMax theory–the unique nonlinear extension of Maxwell’s theory that preserves conformal symmetry and electromagnetic duality invariance. We begin by constructing the Melvin-Bonnor electromagnetic universe in ModMax through a limiting procedure that connects the spacetime of two charged accelerating black holes with that of a gravitating homogeneous electromagnetic field.

arxiv-2411-04255.title: Pose-Transformation and Radial Distance Clustering for Unsupervised Person Re-identification
arxiv-2411-04255.creator: Siddharth Seth, Akash Sonth, Anirban Chakraborty
arxiv-2411-04255.description: Abstract Person re-identification (re-ID) aims to tackle the problem of matching identities across non-overlapping cameras. Supervised approaches require identity information that may be difficult to obtain and are inherently biased towards the dataset they are trained on, making them unscalable across domains. To overcome these challenges, we propose an unsupervised approach to the person re-ID setup.

arxiv-2511-02072.title: Conformal hypersurface invariants and Bach-type Boundary Problems
arxiv-2511-02072.creator: Samuel Blitz ♭ & Rod Gover ♯
arxiv-2511-02072.description: Abstract . Using variational considerations, we establish that there exists a new symmetric trace-free tensor conformal invariant of hypersurfaces embeddings in even dimensional conformal manifolds. This conformal invariant completes the family of conformal invariants known as conformal fundamental forms. The object has important links to global problems.

pmc-11428728.title: Combinatory Effect of Nitroxoline and Gentamicin in the Control of Uropathogenic Enterococci Infections
pmc-11428728.creator: Davorka Repac Antić, Bruno Kovač, Marko Kolenc, Irena Brčić Karačonji, Ivana Gobin, Mirna Petković Didović, Mao Hagihara, Hideo Kato
pmc-11428728.description: Enterococcus faecalis, responsible for a majority of human and nosocomial enterococcal infections, is intrinsically resistant to aminoglycoside antibiotics (such as gentamicin, GEN), which must be used in a combined therapy to be effective. Nitroxoline (NTX) is an old antibiotic, underused for decades, but rediscovered now in an era of growing antibiotic resistance.

pmc-11560903.title: Landscape of targeted therapies for lung squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-11560903.creator: Qiuxuan Chen, Xiaoshuo Zheng, Weiting Cheng, Jian Li
pmc-11560903.description: Lung cancer, a common type of malignant neoplasm, has seen significant advancements in the treatment of lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD). However, the management of lung squamous cell carcinoma (LSCC) continues to pose challenges. Traditional treatment methods for LSCC encompass surgical resection, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy.

pmc-12366135.title: Parasitic infections and the development of endomyocardial fibrosis: systematic review of case reports and case series
pmc-12366135.creator: Abel Aizeque, Alex Mwangi Kihunyu, Olamide Daniel Odusola, Sulymon A. Saka, Abdinasir Mohamed Aray
pmc-12366135.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundEndomyocardial fibrosis (EMF) is a chronic restrictive cardiomyopathy prevalent in tropical regions, often underdiagnosed and associated with poor outcomes. Although its etiology remains unclear, parasitic infections such as schistosomiasis, filariasis, and trypanosomiasis have been implicated in its development.

pmc-13109650.title: A National Hypertension Awareness and Early Screening Initiative: “Act at 30 – It's Time for Heart Check”
pmc-13109650.creator: Uday M. Jadhav, Tiny Nair, Jabir Abdullakutty, Rajeev Garg, T. Govindan Unni, Smit Shrivastava, Rajeev Agarwala, P. P. Mohanan, Sandip Mitra
pmc-13109650.description: India is witnessing a growing burden of early‐onset hypertension and cardiovascular disease, particularly among adults under the age of 40. Despite this trend, current national screening programs predominantly target individuals over 40, resulting in a significant gap in early detection and prevention efforts.

pmc-13295557.title: Polyphenol-Mediated Modulation of Oxidative Stress Pathways in Type 1 Diabetes: A Systematic Review
pmc-13295557.creator: Alan Ho, Harini Adivikolanu, Dilan Patel, Xinyue Wang, Rahul Mittal, Khemraj Hirani
pmc-13295557.description: Oxidative stress is a central component of type 1 diabetes (T1D) pathophysiology, contributing to pancreatic β-cell vulnerability and the development of chronic complications. Current therapeutic strategies are primarily focused on glycemic control and do not directly address underlying redox imbalance.

pmc-13326398.title: Expression of long non-coding RNA NNT-AS1 in children with severe pneumonia and its effect on lipopolysaccharide-induced human embryonic lung fibroblast injury
pmc-13326398.creator: Fanghua Jian, Jun Fu, Dan Li, Weiqiang Bao
pmc-13326398.description: BackgroundSevere pneumonia (SP) threatens the quality of life and well-being of children. This study aims to explore the serum NNT-AS1 expression in SP children and its impact on lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced injury in human embryonic lung fibroblasts.MethodsThe study included 69 SP children, 62 mild pneumonia (MP) children and 75 healthy controls. A pneumonia cell model was constructed with LPS-induced MRC-5 cells.

pmc-13439474.title: An intelligent cloud firewall framework for multi-cloud security using lstm anomaly detection and federated learning
pmc-13439474.creator: Asha V, Kanaga Suba Raja S
pmc-13439474.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The evolving nature of the threat landscape against cloud services is outpacing the capabilities of traditional security measures. Current firewall implementations in cloud services may provide a foundational layer of security, but they have significant limitations regarding their ability to respond to recently identify zero day vulnerabilities and to protect sensitive information from potential attacks utilizing quantum computing, as well as validating audit logs in multi-tenanted, shared cloud service landscapes.
